name: Easy Pressure Cooker "Baked Beans" with Veggie Sausage & Coleslaw

instructions.primary_message: Set a 6-quart electric pressure cooker to sauté on HIGH.
While the pressure cooker heats up, peel, halve, and small dice onion.
Once the pressure cooker insert is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom. Add onion and spices; cook, stirring occasionally, until onion is softened, 3-4 minutes.
instructions.secondary_message:
2 tsp extra virgin olive oil
2 tsp smoked paprika
1 tsp garlic powder
½ tsp salt
½ tsp black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Add broth, beans (dry, not pre-soaked), maple syrup, tomato paste, vinegar, Dijon, and sugar to the insert, then stir to combine. Lock lid and set to pressure cook on HIGH for 90 minutes. Once the beans are done, allow pressure to release naturally for 20 minutes, then manually release any remaining pressure.
instructions.secondary_message:
5 cups vegetable broth
2 cups dry navy beans
⅓ cup pure maple syrup
4 tbsp tomato paste
3 tbsp apple cider vinegar
2 tbsp Dijon mustard
2 tbsp brown sugar

instructions.primary_message: While the pressure is releasing, place shredded cabbage and dressing in a medium bowl, then stir to combine the slaw. Set aside.
instructions.secondary_message:
1 (397 g) bag shredded cabbage (coleslaw mix)
¼ cup coleslaw dressing

instructions.primary_message: Preheat a large skillet over medium-high heat.
While the skillet heats up, slice sausages crosswise into ½-inch thick rounds.

Once the skillet is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom. Add sausage and cook, stirring occasionally, until golden and warmed through, 4-5 minutes (or cook according to package instructions). Remove from heat.
Divide beans and sausage between bowls. Serve with slaw on the side and enjoy!
